translation.title: Naftifine Hydrochloride Cream
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for tinea (ringworm), including athlete's foot (tinea pedis), tinea of the hand (tinea manuum), jock itch (tinea cruris), and ringworm of the body (tinea corporis), as well as cutaneous candidiasis, tinea versicolor, and fungal infection of the nails (onychomycosis).
translation.usage: For fungal skin infections, once a day (preferably at bedtime), clean and completely dry the affected area, then apply a thin layer to the affected skin and the surrounding skin and rub in gently. For fungal nail infection (onychomycosis), trim the nails short and apply a thin layer once a day (preferably at bedtime), or twice a day (morning and evening) if needed. To prevent recurrence, continue for about 2 more weeks after all symptoms have cleared.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it. Before using it, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you are pregnant or may be pregnant or are breastfeeding, or for children. This medicine is for external use only. Do not use it on areas of acute inflammation or on open wounds. Take care to avoid contact with the eyes, nose, mouth, and other mucous membranes. Do not use an occlusive dressing or wrapping unless directed by a doctor. If you have candidiasis, do not use acidic soap. Stop use and consult a doctor or pharmacist if irritation or sensitivity occurs. Rarely, a burning sensation, stinging, dryness, redness (erythema), itching, or local irritation may occur. If you have any questions or notice any problems while using it, consult a pharmacist or other expert at the store.
